item: The branch's executed rate is not the printed board rate
why: The BOC board itself states that the rate applied at internet banking, mobile banking, self-service terminals or the counter governs, and that the table is for reference only
settles_with: A written quote from the executing branch, on the day

item: U.S. receiving-bank and correspondent-bank deductions are blank
why: No official tariff publishes what the receiving bank or an intermediary will deduct on an incoming personal wire; the earlier BOC USA schedule covers outgoing BOC USA services, not this corridor
settles_with: The receiving bank's published incoming-wire tariff plus the MT103 the sender receives

item: Personal OUR (全额到账) availability is unknown
why: The published personal tariff describes the service, but whether a given branch offers it on a personal outward payment is a branch fact
settles_with: A branch answer in writing, quoting code 210104021

item: Counter cash exchange rates are not published
why: The board prints spot and cash buying rates, but the counter's cash selling rate for a walk-in exchange is not on the public tariff
settles_with: A counter quote at the branch that will sell the USD

item: Overseas ATM per-withdrawal fee was not re-verified for this page
why: Only the annual and daily limits (汇发〔2017〕29号) were re-fetched today; the card scheme's per-withdrawal fee and FX margin are commercial
settles_with: The card issuer's current personal tariff schedule

item: Eligibility for QDII and Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect is unknown
why: Both schemes set residency, investment-history and quota conditions per investor; nothing in the sources reviewed establishes eligibility for a U.S. citizen with a mainland balance
settles_with: The scheme's participating bank, in writing

item: The § 988 cost basis of this person's CNY is unknown
why: The gain depends on the exchange rate and date at which the CNY was acquired; no records were supplied, so the tax is shown as a sensitivity range, not a figure
settles_with: The acquisition record: the rate and date of each deposit

item: Whether the balance is already taxed in China is unknown
why: If the money is untaxed PRC-source income, the 20% proportional rate can attach before conversion; if it is after-tax savings, it does not
settles_with: The PRC tax payment certificate or withholding record for the income

item: SAFE approval fees and processing times are not published
why: The 2014 notice sets out the approval route and cancels the RMB 500,000 filing step, but publishes neither a fee nor a service standard
settles_with: The SAFE branch's written service standard

item: The licensed-payment-institution route is not confirmed for personal capital
why: The SAFE payment-institution framework addresses cross-border payment business; no rule was found permitting it to move an individual's savings
settles_with: The institution's SAFE licence scope, in writing

item: The size of the balance in China is unknown
why: Every table here is per USD of value converted, not a projection of this person's total; a USD 400,000 balance is assumed only because the question asked for that range
settles_with: The account balance, which was not supplied

item: CFETS central parity was not independently fetched today
why: Only the BOC parity column (6.7167) was read today; the CFETS mid-rate page is the cross-check used by earlier passes
settles_with: The CFETS 人民币汇率中间价 page, on the day of execution

item: The U.S. marginal rate used in the § 988 table is illustrative
why: 24% and 37% are statutory ordinary rates, but the applicable rate depends on the person's whole return; the table multiplies by them only to show scale
settles_with: The actual return, or a preparer's estimate

item: The 'considerable taxes' in the original question could not be matched to any instrument
why: No document reviewed imposes an exchange or exit tax on converting after-tax principal; the likely candidates are the PRC income tax on the source income, the § 988 gain, or a reporting penalty
settles_with: The tax notice, bank deduction advice or receipt the question refers to

item: Provincial SAFE pages are used as evidence for national rules
why: The Ningxia and Hebei Q&As are branch publications; they quote the national instruments but are not themselves the instrument
settles_with: The national instrument itself (2020 current-account guide, 汇发〔2017〕29号)
